review.why: Designs popups, slide-ins and banners: trigger choice, copy, frequency caps, mobile and accessibility rules, and what to test.
review.summary: Compares triggers (time, scroll, exit intent, click, behavior) and popup types, then gives design, sizing, close-button and mobile rules, copy formulas, frequency capping, targeting, consent and accessibility notes, and search-engine interstitial guidance. It adds metrics with benchmarks, strategies by site type and many test ideas.
strengths: Respect rules: visible close, frequency caps, no guilt-trip decline text
Covers consent, keyboard access and intrusive-interstitial risk
Strategies by site type: e-commerce, B2B software, media, lead generation
cautions: Conversion benchmarks vary widely by audience
Suggests countdown timer tests: only for real deadlines
Gives no code or tool setup
